description: Substring-search the AntFeed provider directory by address, displayName, or service name (case-insensitive). Use for fuzzy discovery; use list_providers to browse, get_pricing for a single price. Returns matched providers with the same shape as list_providers, plus an opaque nextCursor for more matches.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Substring matched (case-insensitive) against address, displayName, or any service name

name: lookup

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page of matches.

totalMatched.description: Total matches across all pages of the searched window

truncated.description: True when explorerTotal exceeds the scanned window
